page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g6a.32xlarge is a general-purpose instance type powered by the KVM hypervisor and x86_64 architecture. It features 128 dedicated vCPUs provided by AMD EPYC 7H12 processors running at a baseline clock speed of 2.6 GHz. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, maintaining a balanced ratio of 4.0 GB of memory per core.

This instance does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, requiring external block storage volumes for persistent data. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 32 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated AMD EPYC hardware profile offers a high-density compute and memory configuration suitable for large-scale deployments that require predictable, non-shared CPU resources without the added cost of bundled local storage or specialized GPU hardware.

Given its balanced resource allocation and high core count, the ecs.g6a.32xlarge is designed for enterprise-grade applications, large-scale web serving, distributed caching, and middle-tier application servers. It is also well-suited for containerized microservices and backend databases that rely on network-attached storage.
